set.body: Source-inspection finding during the sampled convolution allocation repair. HrfCombinators.normalizeWithTransform(dt) in Decorators.scala computes ceil(hrf.span / dt).toInt + 1 without a work bound; block(... normalize=true) repeats this for newSpan. A positive block width much smaller than kernel span can pass the new box-quadrature cap while its normalization count overflows Int and skips the peak loop, silently falling back to scale1; large finite counts instead perform excessive work. Fix both legacy reference-grid paths with documented admission before conversion/evaluation, preserve typed normalization/HrfSpec error boundaries, and audit the fixed-reference HrfNormalizer call chain. Add JVM+JS boundary regressions and bounded mutation evidence, including a tiny-width positive event through HrfGenerators.duration. No unsafe normalization run or enormous allocation was attempted for this finding. This is separate from sampled kernel/drive grids (bd-01M477F67P8ZJKHSCWSPCECG85) and box quadrature (bd-01M43S7GV3M4E6AC1W35DPF17C).
set.title: Bound legacy HRF normalization reference grids before Int conversion
